item.description: By STEPHEN WHYNO MILAN — Johnny Gaudreau’s No. 13 jersey was hanging in the U.S. locker room throughout the Olympics, and Dylan Larkin and Matthew Tkachuk carried it around the ice after the U.S. beat Canada in overtime to win the country’s first gold medal at the Games since 1980. Then, the tribute to the late player known as “Johnny Hockey” went even further. item.title: Jessie Diggins concludes glittering Olympic career on final day of Winter Games
item.description: Jessie Diggins finished fifth in the 50-kilometer mass start cross-country ski race on the final day of the Winter Olympics. Just a few seconds shy of one more medal. She’s OK with that. “I can confidently say I could not possibly have tried harder or gotten more out of my body,” the 34-year-old Diggins said. item.title: USA hockey men win gold: ‘This is all about our country,’ hero Jack Hughes says | Jeff Schudel
item.description: What a great day to be a proud American — 46 years to the day after no one had to apologize for being a proud American. Team USA beat Team Canada, 2-1, in overtime on Feb. 22, in Milan, Italy, to win the gold medal in men’s hockey three days after the United States women’s team beat Canada for gold in overtime by an identical score. item.title: Thornton scores 32, but Ohio State falls to Michigan State, 66-60
item.description: By LARRY LAGE EAST LANSING, Mich. — Carson Cooper scored a career-high 20 points and grabbed 11 rebounds to lead No. 15 Michigan State to a 66-60 win over Ohio State on Feb. 22. Jeremy Fears added 11 points and eight assists for the Spartans (22-5, 12-4 Big Ten), who have won three of four, moving into a third-place tie in the Big Ten with No. 9 Nebraska and No. 7 Purdue. item.title: Short-handed Thunder hit 21 3s to beat Cavaliers, 121-113, snapping Cleveland’s seven-game streak
item.description: By TIM WILLERT OKLAHOMA CITY — Isaiah Joe scored 22 points and Cason Wallace added 20 points and 10 assists to help the short-handed Thunder beat the Cavaliers, 121-113, on Feb. 22. Chet Holmgren had 17 points, 15 rebounds and three blocks for Oklahoma City (44-14), which made 21 of 41 3-point attempts (51.2%), including six by Joe, and converted 17 turnovers into 31 points. item.title: Tyler Reddick wins at Atlanta to give Michael Jordan second straight NASCAR Cup victory
item.description: HAMPTON, Ga. — Tyler Reddick rebounded from a crash to become the first driver in 17 years to sweep the first two races of a NASCAR Cup Series season, winning in double overtime Feb. 22 at Echo Park Speedway. A week after winning the Daytona 500 in a wild final lap, Reddick gave 23XI Racing and co-owner Michael Jordan another victory by outdueling Chase Briscoe, Ross Chastain and Carson Hocevar on the 1.54-mile oval.
